stories.title: Unit and Negative Tests for Allowlist Routing
stories.description: Implement comprehensive unit tests validating that only allowlisted tools can be executed, including negative cases for disallowed tools and invalid Pydantic inputs.

stories.title: Anthropic Tool Use Parsing and Dispatch Integration
stories.description: Implement parsing of Anthropic tool_use blocks and connect them to the allowlist router, ensuring validated inputs are dispatched to correct handlers.

stories.title: FastAPI Integration for Tool Routing Execution Path
stories.description: Integrate the tool router into the FastAPI request lifecycle, ensuring tool calls from chat requests are properly routed, validated, and executed within the API layer.

stories.title: End-to-End Tool Routing Validation with Real Tool Models
stories.description: Validate full routing flow using real tool models (provider search, clinical trials, consent), ensuring schema validation, allowlist enforcement, and handler execution work cohesively.
